entities.name: Azami Ozu
entities.description: Head archivist and librarian at the Minamo School on Kamigawa, driven by a pact with a river spirit to pursue knowledge at any cost.

entities.name: Minamo School
entities.description: School on Kamigawa with the greatest library, where Azami was head librarian.

entities.name: Etsumi Urano
entities.description: Azami's friend, whom she left behind to the nezumi.

entities.name: Atsuko Shimazaki
entities.description: Head of the library and Azami's rival; died of poison.

entities.name: River spirit
entities.description: A river spirit Azami took for a great kami; it made a pact with her and was later found to have no great powers.

entities.name: Kitanosu Temple
entities.description: Temple in nezumi territory holding ancient hidden scrolls.

entities.name: Nezumi
entities.description: Rat folk who attacked Azami and Etsumi.

entities.name: The Unspeakable
entities.description: Spirit whose knowledge drives people mad, studied by Azami through students.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which hunters brought back the river spirit.

events.summary: As a child, Azami made a pact with a river spirit to give everything in pursuit of knowledge.
events.quote: The kami made a pact with Azami who said she would give everything in the pursuit of knowledge.

events.summary: Azami's mother fell into the river and nearly drowned; Azami tended the library instead, and her mother died within a month.
events.quote: Within a month, her mother had died.

events.summary: Attacked by nezumi at Kitanosu Temple, Azami left Etsumi behind to save the scrolls.
events.quote: Azami left Etsumi behind, deeming the scrolls more valuable.

events.summary: Azami poisoned her rival Atsuko with mushrooms, and Atsuko died.
events.quote: Atsuko was killed by the poison after a long and painful illness.

events.summary: Azami became head librarian of the greatest library in Kamigawa.
events.quote: Eventually, Azami became the head librarian of the greatest library in Kamigawa at the Minamo School.

events.summary: Azami studied the captured river spirit and realized it had no great powers.
events.quote: She studied the creature and came to realize that it had no great powers.

relations.quote: became Azami's rival within Minamo School
Azami met and befriended Etsumi Urano
